sn54.7:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Mahākappino avidūre nisinno hoti pallaṅkam ābhujitvā uruṃ kāyam paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satim upaṭṭhapetvā || || 4.
sn54.7:1.3: Addasā kho Bhagavā āyasmantam Mahākappinam avidūre nisinnam pallaṅkam abhujitvā ujuṃ kāyam paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satim upaṭṭhapetvā ||
sn54.7:2.1: Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave etassa bhikkhuno kāyassa iñjitattaṃ vā phanditattaṃ vā ti || || 5.
sn54.7:2.2: Yadā pi mayam bhante tam āyasmantam passāma saṅghamajjhe vā nisinnam ekaṃ vā raho nisinnaṃ || tadā pi mayaṃ tassa āyasmato na passāma kāyassa iñjitattaṃ vā phanditattam vā ti || || 6.
sn54.7:3.1: Yassa bhikkhave samādhissa bhavitattā bahulīkatattā neva kāyassa iñjitattaṃ va hoti phanditattaṃ vā || na cittassa iñjitattam vā hoti phanditattaṃ vā || tassa so bhikkhave bhikkhu samādhissa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī || || 7.
sn54.7:3.2: Katamassa ca bhikkhave samādhissa bhavitattā bahulīkatattā neva kāyassa iñjitattaṃ vā hoti phanditattaṃ vā || na cittassa iñjitattaṃ vā hoti phanditattaṃ vā ||
sn54.7:4.1: Ānāpānasatisamādhissa bhikkhave bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā neva kāyassa iñjitattaṃ vā hoti phanditattaṃ vā na cittassa iñjitattaṃ vā hoti phanditattaṃ vā || || 8.
sn54.7:4.2: Katham bhāvite ca bhikkhave ānāpanasatisamādimhi katham bahulīkate neva kāyassa iñjitattaṃ vā hoti phanditattam vā || na cittassa iñjitattaṃ vā hoti phanditattaṃ vā || || 9--15.
sn54.7:5.1: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati- || vitthāretabbā ||
sn54.7:5.4: Evam bhāvite ca kho bhikkhave ānāpānasatisamādimhi evam bahulīkate neva kāyassa iñjitattaṃ vā hoti phanditattaṃ va || na cittassa iñjitattaṃ vā hoti phanditattam vā ti || || 1--2. Sāvatthi --
